name: Posting queue command — /queue shows unposted videos + daily pace
block: Phase 1 — gate urgency (22 days to Apr 7, 0/30 posts)
goal: Add /queue Telegram command (owner-only). Shows: (1) total videos in publish-ledger.jsonl vs total recorded in manual-posts.jsonl. (2) Top-5 unposted video IDs from ledger (most recent, excluding already-recorded IDs). (3) Daily pace needed to hit Apr 7 gate: (30 - posted)/daysLeft. (4) Inline /record commands for each unposted video ID (pre-filled, operator copies and pastes after viewing). Also add /queue to handleHelp() and index.ts routing.
rationale: /review shows top-3 from latest run only. There are 141 videos in publish-ledger.jsonl that have never been posted. Operator has no 'what to post today' view or awareness of the full queue. /queue closes this gap: shows exactly what videos are ready, how many to post per day, and pre-fills the /record commands to minimize friction.
swarm: NOT USED — 2 file edits + 1 validation script. Direct write.

tasks.title: commands.ts — add handleQueue() owner-only command + update handleHelp()
tasks.description: handleQueue(chatId, ownerChatId): owner gate. Load publish-ledger.jsonl → array of {video_id, published_at}. Load manual-posts.jsonl → Set of recorded video_ids. Compute: ledgerCount=ledger.length, recordedCount=recordedIds.size, unposted=ledger entries where video_id not in recordedIds. Sort unposted by published_at descending, take top-5. daysLeft=Math.max(1,Math.ceil((Apr7-now)/86400000)), postsNeeded=Math.max(0,30-recordedCount), pacePerDay=Math.ceil(postsNeeded/daysLeft). Output: header with ledger/posted/unposted counts, pace line, top-5 list (video_id + /record <video_id> 0 pre-filled), note that views are 0 until operator updates with /update-views. handleHelp(): add '/queue — Posting queue: unposted videos + daily pace (owner)' after /update-views line.
